workload.description: prime_fast::rho_parallel with the negation map on the arXiv 2508.14011 secpkk1 ladder, k = 30..60 step 2 (Algorithm 3 as printed), target 'Quantum' point P, generator 'Challenge' point Q; 64 seeds per level at 30-48 bits, 16 at 50-56, 8 at 58-60
curve_ids: secp30k1 ... secp60k1 (arXiv 2508.14011 Algorithm 3; secp32k1 and secp48k1 match Appendix A)

metric: rho iterations / sqrt(pi n / 4), pooled mean over 720 verified solves
note: Pooled mean 1.077 (s.d. 0.546, s.e. 0.020), median 0.998; per-level means 0.80-1.24; DP start-up overhead estimate 0.12-0.18. The paper's 8/12/16-bit cards follow an ascending prime search, its 6/24/32/48-bit cards the printed descending one.
